The drift gate that could not see cc-adoption-data.ts

The published CC adoption board read Latest known upstream 2.1.220 while shared/cc-support.json said 2.1.231. ci.yml already diffed docs/site/lib/generated/, so the gate looked covered. It was not: a gate is only as good as the build in front of it, and no build step ran the generator that writes that file. Issue #3492.

Build steps versus the gated paths

Generated file (gated by ci.yml)Written by

Determinism: what CI sees on re-run

CI checks out the PR, runs npm run build, then diffs docs/site/lib/generated/. Wiring the generator in means its output is now re-run on every PR, so a stamp that varies per run turns a real gate into a permanent false alarm. 


    

  






  Evidence in the repo: the stale file carried
  GENERATED_AT = { commit: "b56a1fd08", date: "2026-07-26" } and
  latestKnown: "2.1.220" while shared/cc-support.json had advanced to
  2.1.231 on 2026-08-13. The fix regenerates rather than hand-edits the number, which is the
  whole point: a hand-edit would have gone stale again on the next bump.
